name: workspace
purpose: A root package plus two workspace members, one of which depends on the other through the `workspace:` protocol. Exercises workspace declaration and expansion, package identity by path rather than by name, a SECOND scoped package-manager fact from a member's own lockfile, and commands nested per declaring package.
exercises: package identity by path rather than by name
two scoped package-manager facts, one per manifest that states one
workspace dependency edge resolved to the member's package node, with targetMissing false
a member dependency carries no resolved version, because only the root importer is read
